lyrics.ja: 最高の光は　いま目の前にあるよ
lyrics.romaji: Saikou no Hikari ha Ima Me no Mae ni Aru yo
lyrics.en: The greatest light is right before your eyes now
lyrics.zh: 最棒的光芒，此刻就在眼前

lyrics.ja: 積み重ねた物語の結晶
lyrics.en: The crystal of all the stories we've piled up
lyrics.zh: 層層累積的故事結晶

lyrics.ja: 6本目のロウソクまで吹き消したら
lyrics.en: Once we blow out the sixth candle
lyrics.zh: 吹熄第六根蠟燭之後

lyrics.ja: みんなワーワーで　めっちゃパレード!にぎやかがいいよね
lyrics.romaji: Minna Waawaa de Meccha Pareedo! Nigiyaka ga Ii yo ne
lyrics.en: Everyone's cheering—what a parade! Lively is best, right?
lyrics.zh: 大家哇哇歡呼，超盛大的遊行！熱鬧最棒了

lyrics.ja: 全世界の隅々まで　伝えなくちゃ
lyrics.en: I have to spread it to every corner of the world
lyrics.zh: 必須傳達到全世界的每個角落

lyrics.ja: 最大限の “I'm Happy!!!!!!”　フルボリュームで
lyrics.romaji: Saidaigen no "I'm Happy!!!!!!" Furu Boryuumu de
lyrics.en: At maximum "I'm Happy!!!!!!" at full volume
lyrics.zh: 用最大音量喊出「我超開心！！！！！！」

lyrics.ja: まだまだ途中だよね　バテずに一直線
lyrics.romaji: Mada Mada Tochuu Da yo ne Batezu ni Icchokusen
lyrics.en: We're still only partway, right? Without losing steam, straight ahead
lyrics.zh: 還在半路上呢，不顯疲態地筆直向前

lyrics.ja: 果てなきところまでド派手に行きたいじゃん
lyrics.romaji: Hate Naki Tokoro made Dohade ni Ikitai jan
lyrics.en: I wanna go all the way to the endless beyond in flashy style, don't you?
lyrics.zh: 想到無盡的遠方華麗前行，對吧

lyrics.ja: もし　たまにほら 6×6(ムム)ってもさ
lyrics.romaji: Moshi Tama ni Hora Mu Mu tte mo sa
lyrics.en: Even if sometimes, you know, things go "hmm hmm"
lyrics.zh: 即使偶爾，你看，陷入苦思

lyrics.ja: その先に三十六景だ
lyrics.en: Beyond that are thirty-six views
lyrics.zh: 前方還有三十六景

lyrics.ja: ハチャメチャ、でもここまで来たね
lyrics.romaji: Hachamecha, Demo Koko made Kita ne
lyrics.en: It's been chaotic, but we've made it this far
lyrics.zh: 亂糟糟的，但我們也走到這了呢

lyrics.ja: よっしゃー!
lyrics.en: Alright!
lyrics.zh: 好耶！

lyrics.ja: サンキュー!ろろろろ　ロッキュー!まだまだ
lyrics.en: Thank you! Ro-ro-ro-ro, rock you! Not done yet
lyrics.zh: 謝謝！嚕嚕嚕嚕，搖滾你！還早呢

lyrics.ja: Rolling! Loading!　進化中
lyrics.en: Rolling! Loading! Evolving
lyrics.zh: Rolling! Loading! 進化中

lyrics.ja: 最新系の私だ　キミが目撃者だ!
lyrics.romaji: Saishinkei no Watashi Da Kimi ga Mokugekisha Da!
lyrics.en: I'm the latest model—you're the witness!
lyrics.zh: 我是最新型的我，你是見證者！

lyrics.ja: サンキュー!ろろろろ　ロッキュー!回れよ
lyrics.en: Thank you! Ro-ro-ro-ro, rock you! Spin around
lyrics.zh: 謝謝！嚕嚕嚕嚕，搖滾你！旋轉吧

lyrics.ja: Rolling! Loading!　ぐーるりっ
lyrics.en: Rolling! Loading! Round and round
lyrics.zh: Rolling! Loading! 轉圈圈

lyrics.ja: 第六惑星までも届けたいメロディ
lyrics.romaji: Dairoku Wakusei made mo Todoketai Merodi
lyrics.en: A melody I want to send even to the sixth planet
lyrics.zh: 想傳達到第六行星的旋律

lyrics.ja: (ろっろー!ろっろー!)
lyrics.en: (Ro-ro! Ro-ro!)
lyrics.zh: （嚕嚕！嚕嚕！）

lyrics.ja: 風向きよし!
lyrics.en: The wind is in our favor!
lyrics.zh: 風向正好！

lyrics.ja: (ろっろー!ろっろー!)
lyrics.en: (Ro-ro! Ro-ro!)
lyrics.zh: （嚕嚕！嚕嚕！）

lyrics.ja: 空駆ける旅はまだ続いてく
lyrics.romaji: Sora Kakeru Tabi ha Mada Tsuzuiteku
lyrics.en: The journey racing through the sky still goes on
lyrics.zh: 馳騁天空的旅程仍在繼續

lyrics.ja: 6年目が6巻目の　お話なら
lyrics.romaji: Rokunenme ga Roku Kanme no Ohanashi Nara
lyrics.en: If the sixth year is the sixth volume of the story
lyrics.zh: 如果第六年是第六卷的故事

lyrics.ja: とりあえずは　安泰じゃん　打ち切りは回避だ
lyrics.romaji: Toriaezu ha Antai jan Uchikiri ha Kaihi Da
lyrics.en: For now, we're safe—we've avoided cancellation
lyrics.zh: 總之暫時安泰，避免了腰斬

lyrics.ja: でもでもだよ　中だるみは　なりたくない
lyrics.romaji: Demo Demo Da yo Nakadarumi ha Naritakunai
lyrics.en: But, but—I don't want it to drag in the middle
lyrics.zh: 但是但是啊，不想有中段疲軟

lyrics.ja: 通過点なんだ　目指すは6億部です
lyrics.romaji: Tsuukaten na n Da Mezasu ha Roku Oku Bu Desu
lyrics.en: It's just a waypoint—the goal is 600 million copies
lyrics.zh: 這只是個中繼點，目標是六億本

lyrics.ja: 山あり谷ありでも　なんのそのだって!
lyrics.romaji: Yama Ari Tani Ari demo Nan no Sono Datte!
lyrics.en: Even with peaks and valleys, no big deal!
lyrics.zh: 就算有高山低谷，也算不了什麼！

lyrics.ja: 道なき道だろうと強気で GO and GO
lyrics.romaji: Michi Naki Michi Darou to Tsuyoki de GO and GO
lyrics.en: Even on a pathless road, boldly go and go
lyrics.zh: 就算是沒有路的路，也要強勢前進

lyrics.ja: あちゃ　コケちゃって　ぐぬってもさ
lyrics.en: Oops, even if I trip and groan
lyrics.zh: 哎呀，就算跌倒了不甘心

lyrics.ja: 六輪駆動とかどうでしょか!?
lyrics.romaji: Rokurin Kudou to ka Dou Desho ka!?
lyrics.en: How about six-wheel drive or something!?
lyrics.zh: 六輪驅動之類的如何！？

lyrics.ja: 免許無いなら乗り合わしてこうっっ
lyrics.en: If you don't have a license, let's ride together
lyrics.zh: 沒駕照的話就一起搭車吧

lyrics.ja: いっけー!
lyrics.en: Let's go!
lyrics.zh: 衝啊！

lyrics.ja: サンキュー!ろろろろ　ロッキュー!飛ばせよ
lyrics.en: Thank you! Ro-ro-ro-ro, rock you! Let it fly
lyrics.zh: 謝謝！嚕嚕嚕嚕，搖滾你！飛起來吧

lyrics.ja: Rolling! Loading!　ジェット級
lyrics.en: Rolling! Loading! Jet-class
lyrics.zh: Rolling! Loading! 噴射等級

lyrics.ja: 6回転のジャンプすら飛べそうな気がするね
lyrics.romaji: Rokkaiten no Janpu Sura Tobesou na Ki ga Suru ne
lyrics.en: It feels like I could even pull off a sextuple jump
lyrics.zh: 感覺連六圈跳躍都飛得起來呢

lyrics.ja: サンキュー!ろろろろ　ロッキュー!踊れよ
lyrics.en: Thank you! Ro-ro-ro-ro, rock you! Dance
lyrics.zh: 謝謝！嚕嚕嚕嚕，搖滾你！跳舞吧

lyrics.ja: Rolling! Loading!　ぐーるるっ

lyrics.zh: Rolling! Loading! 轉啊轉

lyrics.ja: 6列目のキミもちゃんと聞こえてるかい!?
lyrics.romaji: Roku Retsume no Kimi mo Chanto Kikoeteru Kai!?
lyrics.en: Even you in the sixth row—can you hear me clearly!?
lyrics.zh: 第六排的你也清楚聽見了嗎！？

lyrics.ja: (ろっろー!ろっろー!)
lyrics.en: (Ro-ro! Ro-ro!)
lyrics.zh: （嚕嚕！嚕嚕！）

lyrics.ja: それならよし!

lyrics.zh: 那就好！

lyrics.ja: 空光る星に手を伸ばした
lyrics.romaji: Sora Hikaru Hoshi ni Te wo Nobashita
lyrics.en: I reached out my hand to the stars shining in the sky
lyrics.zh: 向天空中閃耀的星星伸出手

lyrics.ja: 積み上げたら　歌えそうなんだ
lyrics.en: If I stack them up, it feels like I could sing
lyrics.zh: 堆疊起來，就好像能歌唱

lyrics.ja: キラ　キラ　未来

lyrics.ja: 廻り廻る Future View!!!!!!!

lyrics.zh: 想與你一起在本世紀的旅途上閃耀！
